title: Nextcloud Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying and serving the Nextcloud collaboration and file-sync platform.

NEXTCLOUD_VERSION.description: Target Nextcloud server release version or alias (e.g., latest) to deploy.

NEXTCLOUD_PHP_FPM_LISTEN.description: PHP-FPM FastCGI socket path or host:port endpoint executing Nextcloud PHP workers.

NEXTCLOUD_SERVER_NAME.description: Trusted domain and virtual host server_name configured for Nextcloud.

NEXTCLOUD_DB_PASS.description: Password authenticating the Nextcloud database user.

NEXTCLOUD_DB_USER.description: Database username used by Nextcloud to connect to its backing store.

NEXTCLOUD_WWWROOT.description: Filesystem webroot directory containing the Nextcloud server installation.

NEXTCLOUD_DB_NAME.description: Database schema name storing Nextcloud metadata, shares, and user accounts.

NEXTCLOUD_DB_TYPE.description: Database driver backend for Nextcloud (e.g., pgsql, mysql, sqlite).

NEXTCLOUD_WEBSERVER.description: Frontend web server component fronting Nextcloud (e.g., nginx, caddy, httpd).

NEXTCLOUD_LISTEN.description: HTTP bind address:port or UNIX socket exposed by the Nextcloud web server.
